## INDEX.md entry

```text
- **block-test-skips**: Test skip, focus marker (.only) or test-hiding runner option added. Fix the test or the code instead of skipping, focusing or deselecting it. A person may waive a reviewed skip with 'chock: allow test-skip' on the line and commit from their own shell; in the agent a waiver counts only for a line already committed in HEAD, so an agent asks the person rather than writing the pragma itself. Also checked in the agent: before a write, or at the end of the turn, depending on the agent.
```
